headline: Obsessed with making things on the internet.
bio:
I was the kid who was always making things on the internet — and I never grew out of it. YouTube at 14, video editing at 16, freelancing through COVID (enough to pay my own 12th-grade fees), then social media, websites and marketing.

I led production at Ahmedabad's biggest TEDx, discovered UGC, got in front of the camera myself, and started Dot Engage in my third year of college. Since then: 20+ brands, a Shark Tank-funded client, a lot of systems, and a lot of mistakes I learned from.

I'm still figuring things out, but I know one thing: the fastest way to learn is by doing. So that's what I keep doing.

journey.title: Started a YouTube channel
points: Wanted better videos, so I started teaching myself video editing.

journey.title: Freelance video editor
points: COVID turned the obsession into freelancing.
Earned enough to pay my entire 12th-grade fees myself.
Branched into social media, websites and marketing.

journey.title: Switched colleges and started over

journey.title: Joined TEDxPrahladnagar production
points: Ahmedabad's biggest TEDx. Head of Production within six months.

journey.title: Founded DOT PNG Media

journey.title: Started Dot Engage
points: Started it in my 3rd year of college.
20+ brands, systems, SOPs — and plenty of mistakes.
45+ ad videos for a Shark Tank-funded brand.

journey.title: Went in front of the camera
points: Obsessed with hooks, pattern interrupts and retention.

journey.title: Presented research at NICOM 2026
points: “Generational Shift in Saving and Investing: Millennials vs Gen Z”.

journey.title: Still building
points: Scaling Dot Engage, making content and shipping small products like CAT Monitor and Creator OS.
